title: Đề 19: xem thể thao + tàu, máy bay + người gây ấn tượng

questions.stem: In this part, I am going to ask you three short questions about yourself and your interests. You will have 30 seconds to reply to each question.

questions: What are your plans for this evening?
Describe the room you are in/this room.
Please tell me about a famous place in your country?

questions.stem: In this part, I'm going to ask you to describe a picture. Then I will ask you two questions about it. You will have 45 seconds for each response.

questions: 2. Do you enjoy watching sports in a stadium?
3. Have you ever been to a live sports event with your friends or family?

questions.title: Đề 19: xem thể thao + tàu, máy bay + người gây ấn tượng - Part 2

questions.stem: In this part, I'm going to ask you to compare two pictures, and I will then ask you two questions about them. You will have 45 seconds for each response.

questions: Tell me what you see from the two pictures?
Do you prefer traveling by plane or by train? Why?
What are the advantages of public transport?

questions.title: Đề 19: xem thể thao + tàu, máy bay + người gây ấn tượng - Part 3

questions.stem: In this part, I'm going to show you a picture and ask you three questions. You will have one minute to think about your answers before you start speaking. You will have two minutes to answer all three questions.

questions: 1. Tell me a time you met a person who impressed you.
2. How did you feel after meeting this person?
3. What are the benefits of meeting different people?
